DISCOVERY 610, PLAINTIFF'S MOTION TO COMPEL RESPONSES TO INTERROGATORIES: ERIC L. LIFSCHITZ APPEARING FOR PLAINTIFF. MICHAEL G. DESCALSO APPEARING FOR DEFENDANT. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED - AFTER THE FILING OF THE INSTANT MOTION, DEFENDANTS SERVED RESPONSES TO THE SPECIAL INTERROGATORIES AND PLAINTIFF SUBMITTED A SEPARATE STATEMENT OF MATTERS IN DISPUTE. ACCORDINGLY, THE COURT WILL CONSIDER PLAINTIFF'S MOTION AS A MOTION TO COMPEL FURTHER RESPONSES TO SPECIAL INTERROGATORIES. AS TO DEFENDANT PATRICK STACK, THE MOTION IS GRANTED. DEFENDANT IS ORDERED TO PROVIDE FURTHER RESPONSES TO INTERROGATORIES #S: 5, 13, 15, 17, 27, 29, 31, AND 60 WITHIN 14 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. WEST & PRASZKER REALTORS IS GRANTED. AS TO DEFENDANT WEST & PRASZKER REALTORS, THE MOTION IS GRANTED. DEFENDANT IS ORDERED TO PROVIDE FURTHER RESPONSES TO INTERROGATORIES #S: 15, 17, 27, 29, 31, AND 60 WITHIN 14 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. FAILURE TO RESPOND IN A TIMELY MANNER WAS A MISUSE OF THE DISCOVERY PROCESS. SANCTIONS ARE AWARDED AS TO COUNSEL FOR DEFENDANTS ONLY IN THE AMOUNT OF $536.30, TO BE PAID WITHIN 14 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. COMM: BRUCE E. CHAN
